comment: Params 0 and 1 hold the two voltage-range menu settings and have no widget, so no click reaches them. The stage counters are divide-by-two: a stage passes a high level on to the next stage's normalled trigger every second trigger it receives (src/tools/InsAndOuts.hpp:106-124), which makes the four stages a binary ripple counter when no trigger cables are patched past the first. The output range figure of 0 to 8V is the wider setting; the default range gives 0 to 5V.
